# Google Developer Group (GDG) Chapter

> High-performance developer community platform for engineers, creators, and open-source contributors.

## Overview
This platform serves as the central hub for our Google Developer Group chapter. It facilitates peer-to-peer technical knowledge sharing, hands-on workshops, hackathons, and open-source collaborations centered around Android, Google Cloud Platform, Machine Learning, Web Technologies, and Flutter.

## Core Endpoints
- Root Portal: https://gdg-community.dev/
- Members Directory: https://gdg-community.dev/members.html
- Privacy Policy: https://gdg-community.dev/privacy.html
- Terms of Service: https://gdg-community.dev/terms.html
- XML Sitemap: https://gdg-community.dev/sitemap.xml

## Community Tracks
- AI & Machine Learning: On-device inference, Gemini API integration, and model optimization.
- Cloud Systems: Infrastructure engineering, Kubernetes, serverless architecture, and distributed databases.
- Mobile & Modern Web: Android Jetpack, WebAssembly, modern browser APIs, and cross-platform Flutter solutions.

## Code of Conduct
We adhere strictly to the global Google Developer Community Guidelines. Our community fosters an inclusive, respectful, and harassment-free environment for developers across all backgrounds.
